intro: Reset round. The exploration is archived; five new variants (P1–P5) were built from the density rules in DIAGNOSIS_V2.md, next to the two references they replace (v4b, v6). Every variant is dark, prerendered, uses the same full-colour logo tiles and the same six demos in one shared frame.
lookFirst: P5 Specimens: the most crafted and the shortest. Research and MarmotSat are a 3×2 grid of posters drawn from each demo's own data; tap one and the live demo opens in place. 3,035 px on desktop and 4,883 px on mobile, with every demo one tap away.
P3 Research-forward: the most character. Serif titles on near-black; the demos are large numbered plates. Choose it if research should lead, and accept that Work comes after five plates.
P2 SWE classic: the fastest recruiter scan. On desktop the whole experience list fits the first screen beside a pinned name and actions.
P1 Refined and P4 Creative share a skeleton. P1 is the calm baseline; P4 is P1 plus four precise interactions (open a work row, hover the action row, watch the section headings settle).

deleted: Variants v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v7, v8, v9 and candidates C1–C4, with their fonts and assets. All archived on the local branch archive/portfolio-exploration (065d3f6), not pushed.
All photography: the Toronto timelapse (146 frames), Unsplash and YouTube data, their components (ScrollTimelapse) and copy.
YouTube and Unsplash from the social links.
Seven unused font packages; the old reference thumbnails and flag captures on this board (≈ 8 MB).
Chapter data and other dead code left by the deleted variants.
added: DIAGNOSIS_V2.md: a measured density audit of v4b and v6 (words, elements and focal points per screen, cards over 25 words), why v9 and the timelapse rounds failed, and the rules for P1–P5.

P1–P5, built to docs/P_BRIEF.md. All meet: first screen = name, one line, Resume/GitHub/LinkedIn/X/Email; a compact bar with the same actions after the hero; ≤ 25-word cards; details behind disclosure; write-ups on their own pages.

Full-colour official logos on uniform 40×40 vector tiles (OrgTile): Amazon, RBC, UVic, UVic CfAR and MLH. The CfAR mark was downloaded from uvic-cfar.com and traced to vector with the drop shadow removed. Sources and crops: docs/logos/SOURCES.md.

One demo shell: every demo caption is now one line (≤ 25 words) with a Method disclosure; the tracker is labelled 'Real data'; segmented controls wrap by whole option on phones; the ocean demo's '0 m' label no longer collides with the surface line.
This board: density per variant (measured on the production build), Lighthouse, screenshots and a scroll recording per variant, and a critique of each.

variants.name: SWE classic
variants.idea: The classic engineer's two-column portfolio, done precisely. On desktop the name, line, actions and a scroll-tracking section index stay pinned on the left; on the right one grid with a mono date gutter: Experience, Research (stack under the date, 'Run demo', 'Write-up'), Projects, Contact.
variants.type: Inter (48 KB) + Geist Mono (23 KB) with tabular figures. Cool graphite, two greys, one blue accent.
variants.interactions: Whole-row experience disclosures with a spring; hover dims the other rows (mouse only); the index marks the active section; demos mount in place on 'Run demo' with reserved heights; copy email.
critique: The fastest scan: the whole experience list is on the first desktop screen, and each row is role · org, one line and a date.

Over the element budget on the first desktop screen (35 outside the dock): the pinned hero sits beside the full experience list. It's inherent to the two-column layout and was accepted; on mobile the first screen is only the hero.
The most conventional of the five: its identity is precision rather than anything memorable.
Fixed after review: text below the first screen shifted ~22 px on phones when the web fonts arrived. Fallback metrics are now calibrated per weight; 0 px shift at 360–1440.
fixed: Font-swap shift 22 px → 0 (per-weight Inter fallback calibration); two columns start at 1120 px; steering demo reserve re-measured so loading moves the page 0 px.

variants.name: Narrative: the work (reference)
variants.idea: The previous production candidate, kept unchanged as the reference DIAGNOSIS_V2 measured: a pinned time axis with the work told step by step, then an index of the same items.
critique: Measured in DIAGNOSIS_V2: 14,473 px mobile, 7 focal points on the first screen, 42 cards over 25 words, the story and the index describe the same milestones twice.

variants.name: Latent space (reference)
variants.idea: Real steering activations as the scene. Kept unchanged as the second reference.
critique: Measured in DIAGNOSIS_V2: seven sections for three ideas, experience rows at 33–37 words, two steering controls in the hero, 58svh gaps on mobile.

shared: Tiles are built by node scripts/logos.mjs from the official artwork in docs/logos/: Amazon's 'a' icon (Wikimedia Commons), the RBC shield (Wikipedia; RBC Borealis uses it), UVic's shield from uvic.ca's reversed logo on UVic blue, the CfAR wordmark from uvic-cfar.com traced to vector and cropped to 'CFAR' with its orange rule (the full 4.7:1 wordmark is illegible in a square), and MLH's official colour mark cropped to the letter blocks. Pear Care has no public logo, so its tile is typographic ('pc') in neutral colours.

Six demos, one frame: steering (real model outputs), loss masking (exact definition + illustrative conversation), ES, retrieval and ocean (illustrative), and the MarmotSat tracker (real data: CelesTrak TLE, SGP4 in the browser). All lazy-mount near the viewport or on tap; none loads before first paint.
assumptions: The brief says to archive 'main' before deleting; the working branch is redesign, so the archive branch was cut from it (065d3f6). It's local only; nothing was pushed.
Production '/' still serves v4b until you pick a P variant. Only preview deploys were made; www.tanujdargan.com is untouched.
The CfAR logo exists only as a PNG with a drop shadow on uvic-cfar.com; no official vector was found, so the site's logo was traced (source PNG kept in the repo).
The UVic tile uses the shield from uvic.ca's official reversed (white) logo on UVic blue #005493; a full-colour shield file wasn't published at the URL pattern tried.
Density counts come from ~/dev/portfolio-tools/density.mjs on the production build; 'copy words' excludes text inside demos, and element counts exclude demo internals and the lab dock.
Beri is described only as 'a food app I'm building'; a leftover 'Co-founding Beri' page description was fixed.
Community (Hack@JBCNOsh, VikeLabs, CDE) is cut or behind a disclosure in every P variant: it didn't earn a section under the density rules.

Lighthouse accessibility is 96–97 on P1–P3 because axe checks below-the-fold scroll reveals while they're still held at opacity 0.01 (contrast reads 1.01:1). The hold only applies after hydration, so the static HTML, no-JS readers and anyone scrolling before hydration see full contrast; real text contrast is ≥ 4.5:1. P4 and P5 score 100.
